findings.evidence: DifferentialForm/Dolbeault/Basic.lean:410 `theorem delBar_apply_eq_zero_iff (f : SmoothForm I M F 0) (x : M) : (J.delBar f).1 x = 0 ↔ ∀ v, mvfderiv I (fun y ↦ f.1 y 0) x (J x v) = Complex.I • mvfderiv I (fun y ↦ f.1 y 0) x v`
findings.fix: Add a bridge lemma `(J.delBar f).1 x ![v] = J.dbarFunction (fun y ↦ f.1 y 0) x v` (proof: `delBar_apply_apply`, `dbarFunction_apply`, then `(2:ℂ)⁻¹ = ((2⁻¹:ℝ):ℂ)` via `Complex.coe_smul`). Derive `delBar_apply_eq_zero_iff` from `dbarFunction_eq_zero_iff` so the kernel criterion is proved once.
findings.issue: `dbarFunction_eq_zero_iff` restates `SmoothAlmostComplexStructure.delBar_apply_eq_zero_iff` with the same right-hand side, `∀ v, mvfderiv I σ x (J x v) = I • mvfderiv I σ x v`, and proves it again by the same smul/`I_mul_I` argument. The two `∂bar` APIs on functions are not connected.

findings.evidence: Dolbeault/Basic.lean:387 `del_apply_apply … = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (mvfderiv I (fun y ↦ f.1 y 0) x v - Complex.I • …)`; :398 `delBar_apply_apply … + Complex.I • …`
findings.fix: Use the bridge lemma from the first finding, and add the matching one for `del`/`delFunction`. Then reprove `delBar_apply_apply` and `del_apply_apply` as one-line corollaries of `dbarFunction_apply` and `delFunction_apply`.
findings.issue: `dbarFunction_apply` and `delFunction_apply` repeat `delBar_apply_apply` and `del_apply_apply`: the same `½(dσ v ± i dσ(J v))` formulas, stated for functions instead of degree-0 smooth forms.

findings.evidence: Dolbeault/Holomorphic.lean:88 `delBar_apply_eq_zero_iff_isPseudoholomorphicAt`; :122 `delBar_ofComplexManifold_apply_eq_zero_iff … ↔ MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℂ, E) 𝓘(ℂ, F) (fun y ↦ f.1 y 0) x`
findings.fix: After adding the bridge lemma, prove the Dolbeault versions from the `dbarFunction` ones, using `hf.mdifferentiableAt` from the smooth-form hypothesis. Then each kernel characterization has one proof.
findings.issue: `dbarFunction_eq_zero_iff_isPseudoholomorphicAt` and `dbarFunction_ofComplexManifold_eq_zero_iff` run parallel to `delBar_apply_eq_zero_iff_isPseudoholomorphicAt` and `delBar_ofComplexManifold_apply_eq_zero_iff`. Both pairs make the same kernel statements and go through `isPseudoholomorphicAt_iff_mfderiv` and `isPseudoholomorphicAt_ofComplexManifold_iff` separately.

summary: `dbarFunction`/`delFunction` repeat the existing degree-0 Dolbeault `∂bar`/`∂` API (apply formula, kernel criterion, pseudoholomorphic and holomorphic kernels), proved again with no link between them. Nothing else in the PR duplicates Mathlib or TauCeti: the `mvfderiv_smul_algebra` generalization, the torus migration and the Planar file are new.
